title: Lemma 4.9: quasi-coherence preserved by pushforward along a closed immersion
statement_scope: Let f:(X,OX)→(Y,OY) be a map of spectral Deligne-Mumford stacks whose underlying geometric morphism X→Y is a closed immersion in Top. Then the pushforward f*:ModOX→ModOY carries quasi-coherent sheaves to quasi-coherent sheaves. The statement and its full proof are retained.
difficulty_reason: Rule author-work-bearing-core-v1-20261114: the unit gives a concrete non-routine argument that pushforward along a closed immersion preserves quasi-coherence, using left t-exactness, a limit of truncated objects, hypercompleteness, Proposition VIII.2.3.21, Lemma 4.8 and Corollary VIII.2.5.22 with Lemma 4.7 (statement and proof page 21). Above routine qualifying-exam work but supporting Theorem 4.4.

difficulty_evidence.bearing_core: Quasi-coherence of f*F for a closed immersion, via t-exact truncation, hypercompleteness and coherence of homotopy groups.
